title: BRICS - Women Leaders Summit 2026 at Banasthali Vidyapith
body:
## What the official sources say

- Banasthali Vidyapith will be hosting the BRICS Women Leaders Summit 2026.
- The BRICS Women Leaders Summit 2026 will take place from 19 to 23 November 2026.
- More than 120 women leaders from over 20 BRICS+ countries will attend the Summit.
- The formal opening ceremony of the Summit is expected to be attended by ambassadors of the participating nations and senior officials of the Government of India.
- Banasthali Vidyapith is the world's largest Residential Women’s University.
- The Summit marks the first time it is happening in India.
- Banasthali Vidyapith states that admission is open to women only, irrespective of race, religion, caste, colour, or domicile.
- Banasthali Vidyapith describes its educational programme as Panchmukhi Shiksha, aimed at the all-round harmonious development of personality.

## What to check next

Dates, fees, eligibility and requirements can change. Confirm every time-sensitive detail in the current official notice before making a decision.
